definitions.explanation: The art of writing; literature as a creative and artistic pursuit. Encompasses novels, poetry, drama, essays, and other written forms of artistic expression.

examples.japanese: {文芸|ぶんげい}{作品|さくひん}を{読|よ}む。
{大学|だいがく}で{文芸|ぶんげい}{批評|ひひょう}を{学|まな}んでいる。
examples.english: I am studying literary criticism at university.

examples.japanese: その{雑誌|ざっし}は{文芸|ぶんげい}{欄|らん}が{充実|じゅうじつ}していて、{毎号|まいごう}{新人|しんじん}{作家|さっか}の{短編|たんぺん}が{掲載|けいさい}される。
examples.english: That magazine has a rich literary section, with a short story by a new author published in every issue.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in compound nouns and as a general term for literary culture. Common in academic and publishing contexts. Not used for non-literary writing (technical, journalistic, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文芸|ぶんげい}{作品|さくひん}: literary work
- {文芸|ぶんげい}{批評|ひひょう}: literary criticism
- {文芸|ぶんげい}{雑誌|ざっし}: literary magazine
- {文芸|ぶんげい}{欄|らん}: literary section/column
- {文芸|ぶんげい}{部|ぶ}: literary club (school)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {文学|ぶんがく}: literature (academic field, broader scope)
- {文芸|ぶんげい} emphasizes the artistic/creative dimension, while {文学|ぶんがく} is the broader academic term
